issues.claim: V09 §3.8 (3) (l.1253–1256; J-V9.137, new this round) re-issues a journalled advance that Stop ended by having 'the shell call cancelAdvance when the job's onProgress (§11.2) reports epoch stoppedAfter running'. §12's progress rule (l.15658–15660) posts a non-stage wait's Progress 'as each of its own steps completes', so no message reports epoch 1 running (a stop after the first epoch can never be reproduced) and any other stop holds only if the cancel crosses threads before the next epoch starts.
